name: pathfinder-ai-monorepo
description: PathFinder AI - Next-generation AI-powered career and learning pathway navigator

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "FRONTEND,BACKEND,AI-SERVICE" -c "cyan.bold,green.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:ai"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install && npm run install:ai
scripts.install:ai: cd ai-service && (python3 -m venv venv 2>/dev/null || true) && ./venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
